newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt air cargo rises 5.8 pct in January 1997.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt air cargo rises 5.8 pct in January 1997.

text.p: Total air cargo handled at Frankfurt airport (FRA) in January rose 5.8 percent to 100,961 tonnes, airport authority figures showed.

With production only generally resuming only in the second week following the New Year break and heavy cancellation of flights due to bad weather, there was a slow start, the monthly Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) traffic report said.
But a good second half of the month with 10 percent growth in cargo traffic are good pointers for positive growth over the coming months, it added.
Cargo flown on passenger aircraft in January rose 1.2 percent to 57,177 tonnes while cargo on freighter flights increased 5.9 percent to 41,095 tonnes.
